page.notes: Running head and page number read as printed. The catchword "pa-" stands at the foot right and is not repeated in the text. Ee 2 is the gathering signature. Uncertain readings: the first Greek word (ἐυδοκία), the Greek in the passage on revealing (τὸ), "loquaturtu" and "Salvatorde" are run together or unclear in the scan, and "objectnm" may be a printing error for "objectum". The marginal reference "Armin. dij." is read as printed; the abbreviation may be "dis." Greek accents and breathings in the quotation from Scripture are uncertain. Marginal reference "Contr. Amst-fium pag. 52." is read across two lines in the margin.
